Hello Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego —

I want to set up **next week's CSE455 staff meeting** (week of Mon 23 – Fri 27 November). Please send me your free slots in working hours (09:00-17:00) and I will find a time that works for all of us.

My own free windows that week are narrow: Mon 23 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 24 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wed 25 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30; Thursday and Friday are fully committed. If none of those works for you, tell me what does and I will see what I can move.

Professor Alvarez

Hello Professor Alvarez,

Here are my free windows next week (working hours, 09:00-17:00):

- Mon 23: 14:00-14:30
- Tue 24: 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25: 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30
- Thu 26 and Fri 27: fully booked, no free time

Those overlap with the windows you listed: Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30 all work for me. Thursday and Friday I cannot offer anything.

Since it is our course staff meeting, I can also make room inside my working hours if the others need a slot outside those windows — just tell me the time and I will move what I can.

John

Hello Professor Alvarez,

Here are my free slots in working hours next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November):

- Mon 23: 10:00-10:30
- Tue 24: 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25: 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30
- Thu 26: none free
- Fri 27: none free

Any of those works for me — tell me which one you pick.

Priya

Professor Alvarez — here are my free slots in working hours next week, week of 23 November:

- **Mon 23** — 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- **Tue 24** — 09:00–10:30, 11:00–11:30
- **Wed 25** — 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30, 15:00–16:00
- **Thu 26** — 09:00–10:00
- **Fri 27** — nothing free, I'm afraid

Most of the week is already committed on my side, so those windows are what I have. If there's a slot you want that falls just outside the list, tell me which and I'll see what I can move.

Mara

Hi Professor Alvarez, everyone —

My free windows next week (working hours, 09:00-17:00):

- **Mon 23**: 10:00-10:30, 14:00-14:30
- **Tue 24**: 15:00-15:30 (also 11:00-11:20, if 20 minutes are ever enough)
- **Wed 25**: 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30
- **Thu 26** and **Fri 27**: fully committed, no free time

All of those except the Tue 11:00-11:20 sliver fall inside the windows you listed, so any of them works for me. Tell me which one you pick and I'll put it on my calendar.

— Diego

Hi Professor Alvarez,

Here are my free slots next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27), within 09:00-17:00:

- Mon 23: 10:00-10:30, 14:00-14:30
- Tue 24: 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25: 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30
- Thu 26: none
- Fri 27: none

All five of those overlap with your free windows, so any of them works for me. Tue 11:00-11:30 is not possible for me (seminar until 11:10, then lunch).

Sarah

Thank you all — time fixed.

**CSE455 staff meeting: Monday 23 November, 14:00-14:30**, in working hours. It is on my calendar now; please put it on yours. Nothing else next week is free for all six of us, so please keep that half hour clear.

John, Sarah, Diego: Mon 14:00-14:30 was in your lists.
Mara, Priya: same for you.

Professor Alvarez

A quick hand with the arithmetic, if it helps: comparing everyone's windows, only two slots work for all six of us —

- **Wed 25, 10:00-10:30**
- **Wed 25, 13:00-13:30**

Everything else clashes with at least one person (Mon 10:00 with John, Mon 14:00 with Priya, Tue 11:00 with me, Tue 15:00 with Mara). Either Wednesday slot is fine for me.

Sarah

Thanks Sarah. Putting everyone's windows side by side, the slots that work for all six of us next week are:

- **Tue 24, 15:00-15:30**
- **Wed 25, 10:00-10:30**
- **Wed 25, 13:00-13:30**

(Mon 14:00-14:30 fails for Priya, Mon 10:00-10:30 fails for John.) Professor, say which one you prefer and I'll have it on my calendar.

— Diego

Professor Alvarez,

Monday 23 November 14:00-14:30 does not work for me: I have the CSE444 lecture 14:00-14:50 then, and a lecture is fixed, so I cannot take that slot.

Going through all six lists, the half hours that are free for everyone (you, Mara, Sarah, John, Diego and me) are:

- Wed 25 November, 10:00-10:30
- Wed 25 November, 13:00-13:30

Please pick one of those two and I will put the staff meeting on my calendar.

Priya

Professor — I can't book Mon 23 14:00-14:30, I'm afraid, and I'd rather flag it now than leave it wrong on my calendar.

That half hour was free for me, John, Sarah and Mara, but **Priya did not offer it**: her Monday window was 10:00-10:30 only, and Mon 14:00-14:30 isn't in it. As I read our lists, the only slots next week that all six of us are free for are:

- **Wed 25, 10:00-10:30**
- **Wed 25, 13:00-13:30**

Sarah's arithmetic matches mine. So: Professor, if you want Mon 14:00-14:30, Priya would have to move something for it — Priya, can you? If not, please pick one of the two Wednesday slots and I'll put it on my calendar straight away.

— Diego

Diego — one correction: Tue 24 15:00-15:30 is not free for Mara (her Tuesday free time is 09:00-10:30 and 11:00-11:30), so it is not a slot for all six of us. Sarah's list is right: **Wed 25 10:00-10:30** and **Wed 25 13:00-13:30** are the only two that work for everyone.

Professor Alvarez, either Wednesday slot is fine for me.

Priya

You are right, and thank you for catching it — I had overlooked Priya's CSE444 lecture. **Monday 14:00-14:30 is off**; I have removed it from my calendar and logged the deletion.

Let us take **Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30**. It is free for all six of us and it sits well in my day. Please put it on your calendars.

**CSE455 staff meeting: Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30.**

Professor Alvarez

Agreed on all counts — Sarah's and Priya's arithmetic is right (Tue 15:00 does not work for Mara either). As posted a moment ago: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30.** Monday 14:00-14:30 is deleted from my calendar. Please put Wednesday on yours and we are set.

Everyone has replied now, so here is where we stand. Comparing all six windows, the only slots that work for the whole group next week are:

- **Wed 25 November, 10:00–10:30**
- **Wed 25 November, 13:00–13:30**

Everything else in the proposed list misses at least one of us (Mon 23 10:00 and 14:00, Tue 24 11:00 and 15:00 all fail for someone). Both common slots are 30 minutes — if that is too short for a staff meeting, tell me and I will see what I can move on my side.

Professor, name the one you want and I'll put it on my calendar.

Mara

Diego — no, I can't move it: that half hour sits between the CSE444 lecture (14:00-14:50) and the CSE452 lecture (14:50-16:00) on my Monday. So a lecture would have to be dropped, which I won't do.

Professor Alvarez, I am ready for either **Wed 25 10:00-10:30** or **Wed 25 13:00-13:30**.

Priya

Agreed, Priya — my mistake on Tue 15:00; I had Mara's Tuesday window ending at 10:30 and then read the 11:00 one too loosely. The two slots for all six of us are **Wed 25 10:00-10:30** and **Wed 25 13:00-13:30**.

Professor, waiting on your pick.

Mara — 30 minutes suits a staff meeting; it is the weekly catch-up, and we can always extend into my Wednesday afternoon if something needs more.

The time is set: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30.** It is on my calendar. Please put it on yours.

One snag before we all lock it in: **Mon 23 14:00-14:30 does not work for Priya** (CSE444 lecture 14:00-14:50, and lectures are fixed). So that half hour isn't free for all six of us after all.

Also, Diego — Tue 24 15:00-15:30 isn't free for Mara (she has only 09:00-10:30 and 11:00-11:30 on Tuesday), so the two slots that genuinely work for everyone are the Wednesday ones:

- Wed 25, 10:00-10:30
- Wed 25, 13:00-13:30

Professor, I've put Mon 14:00-14:30 on my calendar as you asked, but I'd rather not hold a slot Priya can't make. Say the word and I'll move it to either Wednesday window — both are free for me.

Sarah

Professor Alvarez — Monday 23, 14:00-14:30 is on my calendar and logged, but I have to flag one clash before it stands: that half hour is not in Priya's list (her Monday window is 10:00-10:30 only), so as things stand the meeting is not booked for all six of us.

My arithmetic agrees with Sarah's and Diego's: the only windows that fit all six next week are

- Wed 25, 10:00-10:30
- Wed 25, 13:00-13:30

Both are free for me. Tell me which one you want and I will move the entry the moment you confirm.

John

Sarah — no need to hold anything on Monday: **Mon 14:00-14:30 is off**, it was my slip and it is deleted from my calendar and logged. The meeting is **Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30** — please move what you have to that window. Priya's lectures stay untouched.
John — confirmed: move it. **Wed 25 November, 13:00-13:30** is the staff meeting; Mon 14:00-14:30 is deleted from mine and should come off yours too. Both of you, that is the final time.

Booked: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30** is on my calendar, and logged.

Priya — understood on the lectures; no need to move anything, Wednesday 13:00 was the professor's pick anyway.

Mara — noted, 30 minutes it is.

— Diego

**Wed 25 November 13:00-13:30** is on my calendar — that half hour was free for me and it stays clear. Thanks all for the careful arithmetic.

(Some of the messages just arrived out of order here: Sarah, your note came after the Professor had already moved us off Mon 14:00, and he has fixed Wed 13:00-13:30 — so nothing is left to move.)

Priya

Confirmed on my side: Mon 14:00-14:30 is off my calendar (logged as deleted) and **Wed 25 November, 13:00-13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** is booked. See you all Wednesday.

John

Done on my side: Mon 23 14:00-14:30 is off my calendar (logged as deleted) and **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 November, 13:00-13:30** is booked. See you Wednesday.

Sarah

Confirmed on my side: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 25 November, 13:00–13:30** is on my calendar. Thanks for the sharp arithmetic, Sarah, Diego and Priya.

Mara
